title: Cortex NightCrewWorkPack (DRAFT v0)
description: A batch of background read-only work items for the nightly loop. Represents a collection of analysis tasks to be processed during the night crew cycle. Per ADR-0014, authored once in cortex/contracts/ and imported by every consumer.

pack_id.description: ULID/UUID — unique identifier for this work pack.

generated_at.description: When this pack was generated (ISO-8601 UTC).

kind.description: The kind of work to perform.

target.description: The target of the work (path, URL, identifier).

rationale.description: Rationale for why this item is in the pack.

items.description: The work items in this pack.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens that can be consumed for this pack.

max_usd_cents.description: Maximum USD cents that can be spent.

budget.description: Budget constraints for executing this pack.
